name: What are common accessible bathroom modifications?

mainEntity.name: What are common accessible bathroom modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common accessible bathroom modifications include installing grab bars in showers and next to toilets, converting bathtubs to walk-in or roll-in showers with zero-threshold entry, raising toilet heights, and installing non-slip flooring. Other modifications may involve adjustable-height showerheads, lever-style faucets, and accessible vanity designs to allow wheelchair clearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common bathroom modifications include grab bars, walk-in/roll-in showers, raised toilets, non-slip flooring, and accessible vanity designs.
